Watch Desk historical item identity catalogue

Derived from the ItemDB-v1.7.0 TBC static snapshot, copyright 2026 Pimptasty,
CurseForge project 1558208. Original core names/item fields: TOG Tools Item DB
walk / client DB2, source build 20505. Snapshot prepared 2026-10-22;
Watch Desk includes only ID, English name, quality and item class. These are
historical identity records, not verified Anniversary server availability.
No prices, bait ideas, suggested watches, private market data, accounting, source
places, executable ItemDB code or saved settings are included.
